verdicts.reason: A is broken: the three steps are scattered around the CTA in the order 02, 03, 01, their body text is microscopic and unreadable, the coffee bag and logo are shrunk into a cramped cluster at the bottom, the legal text wraps into a narrow column, and the oversized headline crowds out everything else. B keeps the original structure and stays readable and on brand, but it reads as a pasted copy of the original with ragged left edges: logo and headline sit at about x=104, the numbers at about 128 and the CTA at about 91. The step 01 line also sits right at the bottom edge of the beige circle.
